principle: Few governed product inputs compose many semantic, recipe and family-private outputs.
cardinalityLaw: One public control has one semantic lowering authority, emits many governed internal channels, and reaches many canonical families, parts and states. Internal channels may have many productive consumers but never competing semantic owners.

namespaceLifecycle.law: --ds-* is the public canon; --_ds-* is a governed private/provisional namespace; data-* is the governed DOM-attribute axis. Product or vertical dialects are forbidden in both token namespaces.

publicCanon.mintingAuthority: contract/control declaredOutputs or Expert allowlist entry
publicCanon.note: Minting a public channel requires an atomic migration with static/DB lowering, consumer propagation, exact restore and predecessor retirement.

privateProvisional.scope: component-private or family-prototype socket below the tenant pipeline
forbidden: using extension declarations as a deferral mechanism

attributeAxis.scope: root attributes and host adaptation, not a token namespace

namespaceLifecycle.drainLaw: A drain cohort may not move an extension declaration into --_ds-* merely to defer a decision. Each cohort migrates, derives or retires its declarations; provisional sockets are for evaluation with a written exit, not for parking extension debt.

executionTraversal.designFirst: Materialize every active Standard and Pro control against all 255 canonical family IDs before broad propagation. Every certifying cell is APPLICABLE, INVARIANT_WITH_REASON, NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON or UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN blocks family completion. Proposed controls live only in the target model and never create certifying cells or block R0-R6.
executionTraversal.controlCalibration: For each operational control, prove domain, stops, static and DB lowering, representative family computed deltas, negative controls and exact restore before treating propagation as mechanical.
executionTraversal.familyClosure: After the control matrix and harness are stable, visit each family once and close every applicable control, part, state, property group and stress case in one packet.
executionTraversal.testCadence: Run focal causal gates per control or family packet. Run the full suite only at reconciliation boundaries and classify every red result before changing source or expectations.

transportEquality.law: Static BrandTheme and DB TenantThemeDocument are transports only. Both resolve to the same complete nested Theme and enter exactly one compileTheme. Equivalent values produce identical keypaths, channel inventory, deterministic order, CSS and digest. ThemePatch exists only at ingestion and never reaches the compiler.
transportEquality.inventory: public-layer only: --ds-* emissions, root attributes, deterministic order, CSS and digest. Private --_ds-* sockets are downstream of lowering and must resolve identically per transport because they read the same derived channels.
forbidden: slug or product branch in compiler

artDirectionProjection.law: Art direction is expressed through the existing pipeline; it is not a new tier, compiler, CSS authority or tenant branch.
artDirectionProjection.migrationLaw: Published profile ids keep their meaning. A new art direction either composes existing axes without semantic mutation or adds a reviewed versioned registry entry through the same static and DB lowering path.
artDirectionProjection.advisorLaw: Fable and Kimi may advise read-only. Their narratives are ephemeral; only a Codex-reproduced source finding enters this model or an owning canonical contract.

r7Execution.entryLaw: R7 begins only from a Codex-accepted R6 frozen baseline and cannot silently reclassify R0-R6 history.
r7Execution.benchmarkLaw: External systems provide ideas, edge cases and capability comparisons only. Existing Rottay semantic names and authorities win; no wholesale source, styling, markup, naming or trade-dress copy.
r7Execution.catalogLaw: The certified 255-family denominator remains fixed during R7. A genuine missing-family proposal requires a separate owner-approved follow-on.

targetControlModel.law: These names are a target taxonomy only. They never count as operational coverage and may not coexist with an equivalent operational control. Each adoption is an atomic migration with predecessor retirement.

migrationOrder.note: Existing Standard control; calibrate without renaming.
Do not create this public ID beside the existing Pro expressive axis.
High-leverage global slice after the evidence method is calibrated.

migrationOrder.predecessor: MotionProfile plus motion.dial plus deprecated BrandMotion
migrationOrder.note: No lowering or stop table exists; consolidate authority before adoption.

productEditorFieldTarget.note: Fields are grouped projections of seven capabilities, not new capability IDs.

groupEmphasis.law: Extend chrome.families/family emphasis; never create a second global intensity system.

expert.presentation: Searchable domain browser with preview, not 294 sliders.

recipeGroupExpansion.admissionRule: Add a group only when at least two productive families share it and two plausible tenant postures require it.

controlImpactContract.authorshipLaw: These fields describe the GENERATED control -> family/part/channel view, never the authored control manifest. Read as a requirement on the authored segment they contradicted schema.json#segments.control.forbidden and the generator, which both refuse a control that hand-lists a family edge; nothing enforced either half, so `representativeFamilyIds` and a factually wrong `mountClassIds` survived inside `calibration` unchecked. Families own the edge; manifest/index.json#generatedControlFamilyView projects it.

leverage.roundExit: non-decreasing; Standard controls must remain high leverage

orthogonality.duplicateControlRule: If consumer/property-group Jaccard similarity exceeds 0.80, derive or merge unless an owner records an independent semantic invariant.
